passages.excerpt_preview: "Today my Vedic ritual is enriched with your advent, whereby I deem that gods  have fructified the ritual. Let the ritual be like that. I deem that I have  obtained the fruit of the ritual just on seeing godlike you here today.  "Oh, Brahma
